name: Rick & Jeanne Hayes
quote: After finding out about the Bluffs by accident, my wife and I made a trip up to take a look. We were dead set on lake front property, until we saw the view. We selected a lot and started the process. Prior to making our final decision we made one more trip back, but this time we went by way of Cheaha Mountain State Park and stopped at most of the Scenic Overlooks to see what the State of Alabama considered breathtaking views. The views were incredible. We used this as a benchmark for the view we were about to purchase. Upon arriving at the site for the second time we were convinced that the views from The Bluffs were 10 times more breathtaking than anything we had seen in Cheaha Mountain State Park. The decision was made and we became new lot owners in the Bluffs.

name: Leigh & Jeff Crews
quote: We had always wanted a few acres with a serene view, but, after years of looking for just the right thing, we had about given up. We saw a "Bluffs" billboard, and went to see, expectations firmly in check. As we turned down Arrowhead Ridge and crested the ridge, the view took our breath away. (It still does, every time we go, in every season, no matter the weather.) We knew from that moment that this was OUR place and we can't wait to put our roots down there.

name: Vince & Amy Wang
quote: We were surprised to find a lake development that offered fantastic views, wide-open spaces, great amenities, a friendly community, and an opportunity to get away from traffic and crowds all less than 2 hours from Atlanta.

name: Mary E. Gossett
quote: I love the idea of the community garden, it takes me back to my childhood days — my father was a big farmer/tomato man/gardener, he was way before his time, and we always had fresh everything, and it was wonderful. It is a great way to get together, when sometimes neighbors might otherwise never get to meet.
